item.gazeofthepantheon.marked_dirt: Death Has Its Eyes on You
tooltip.gazeofthepantheon.marked_dirt.de: §7Place the dirt into a crafting table and offer your soul to Death, so He shall trouble you no more.
tooltip.gazeofthepantheon.thanatos_wrath: §cThe dead don't come back. You know that.
tooltip.gazeofthepantheon.thanatos_kindn: §eThanatos will no longer meddle in your cycle of life and death—so long as you don't wish to die.
§cWounds no longer heal on their own. Only firelight and dreams grant you brief respite.
tooltip.gazeofthepantheon.hygieia_kindne: §eHygieia watches over you. Life force surges without end.
tooltip.gazeofthepantheon.ares_wrath.eff: §cAres's fury burns within you. Everywhere, hostility.
§eAres grants you victory. The eyes of your enemies slip from you.
tooltip.gazeofthepantheon.xihe_wrath.des: §4Gaze: Scorching Sun Doth Burn the Flesh
tooltip.gazeofthepantheon.xihe_wrath.eff: §cFlame Clings unto Thy Flesh, Its Blaze Doth Seethe
§eBorn in Fire, Thou Dost Find Rest in Flame
tooltip.gazeofthepantheon.achilles_wrath: §cAll armor is vain; only flesh remains.
tooltip.gazeofthepantheon.achilles_kindn: §eThe waters of the Styx flow once more.
tooltip.gazeofthepantheon.edict.stats: §e+20 Armor · +20 Toughness · +200% Attack · +10 Attack Speed · Full Knockback Immunity

jei.gazeofthepantheon.deed_drop.desc: Equip the Inevitable Edict, gather all blessed gazes, then slay the Ender Dragon.
jei.gazeofthepantheon.deed_drop.line1: Equip the Inevitable Edict, gather all blessed gazes,
jei.gazeofthepantheon.deed_drop.line2: then slay the Ender Dragon — the Deed shall appear above the End portal.
message.gazeofthepantheon.thanatos_wrath: §4In your final moments, take one last look at this world.

message.gazeofthepantheon.war_gods_recog: §6"Take up your arms. Fight for glory."
